meta.title: Ondra Desktop Pet Entry
meta.description: The capability entry point for the desktop pet, shipped as a skeleton. The first line of handbook section 6.3 is do not build it yourself: airi, ondra-whale-girl-live2d, ondra-pet and agentpet already exist, the last two under MIT, while Coopanion is AGPL-3.0 and may only be read for ideas. So this package draws no window, no sprite and no Live2D, and does four things an entry point should do. First, a licence gate that turns the rule about AGPL into an executed check, so wiring Coopanion is refused outright instead of depending on someone remembering, because a static AGPL inclusion changes the distribution obligations of the whole product. Second, bridge safety: a local WebSocket bridge must check Origin plus a one-shot token, which is the CSWSH lesson, so a non-loopback host, a token inside the URL, or an empty origin list is rejected, and an empty origin list means deny-all rather than no restriction. Third, a single-instance state machine, because two pets on one desktop do not make it livelier, they make it impossible to tell which one is her. Fourth, a render downgrade: a live2d request is refused honestly instead of showing a black window, since Cubism Core is proprietary and not redistributable and the handbook defers that phase. Capability search across desktop packages returned zero hits for anything pet related, and this repository forbids installing dependencies, so the bridge is a port and a missing implementation reports not wired rather than pretending she is already on the desktop. No tool is registered at all, because summoning is a user action and letting the model open a window would overstep its role.
